name: shots
title: Shots
description: Capture screenshots, upload them to S3-compatible storage, and copy the public URL.
author: danieljvdm

preferences.name: endpoint
preferences.title: S3 Endpoint
preferences.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL. For Cloudflare R2, use your account endpoint.

preferences.name: bucket
preferences.title: Bucket
preferences.description: Bucket name for uploaded screenshots and clipboard images.

preferences.name: region
preferences.title: Region
preferences.description: S3 region value used by the SDK. Cloudflare R2 usually uses auto.

preferences.name: accessKeyId
preferences.title: Access Key ID
preferences.description: S3 access key ID with permission to upload objects.

preferences.name: secretAccessKey
preferences.title: Secret Access Key
preferences.description: S3 secret access key for the access key ID.

preferences.name: publicBaseUrl
preferences.title: Public Base URL
preferences.description: Public URL prefix mapped to your bucket or custom domain. Copied links use this prefix.

preferences.name: keyPrefix
preferences.title: Key Prefix
preferences.description: Optional object key prefix, e.g. shots.

preferences.name: forcePathStyle
preferences.title: S3 Client
preferences.description: Use path-style requests for broader S3-compatible support.
preferences.label: Force path style

preferences.name: maxUploadBytes
preferences.title: Compression Target Bytes
preferences.description: Maximum image upload size target in bytes.

preferences.name: maxRetries
preferences.title: Upload Retries
preferences.description: Maximum upload retries for transient failures.

commands.name: take-screenshot
commands.title: Take Screenshot
commands.description: Capture a region, compress, upload, and copy the URL.

commands.name: upload-clipboard-image
commands.title: Upload Clipboard Image
commands.description: Upload the current clipboard image file and copy the public URL.

commands.name: test-upload
commands.title: Test Upload Settings
commands.description: Verify your S3-compatible upload settings without taking a screenshot.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
